name: bb-plugin-inline-media
description: Play videos and audio inline in bb threads: ::video, ::audio and ::media directives, a Play media message action, and play buttons on media file links.

bb.name: Inline Media
bb.description: Play videos and audio inline in bb threads. Agents write ::video{file="out/demo.mp4"} or ::audio{file="memo.m4a"}, and Play media on any message plays the files it mentions or attaches. Nothing autoplays and only media files from the thread are served.
